{{Quote|It must be their artillery!|The Muun to during the [[Battle of Muunilinst/Legends|Battle of Muunilinst]]|<ref name="Chapter 4">{{CW|4}}</ref>}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''unidentified [[Muun/Legends|Muun]]''' was a member of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During the [[Battle of Muunilinst/Legends|Battle of Muunilinst]], this Muun was among the Banking Clan leaders that oversaw the battle via [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]]. When the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] managed to destroy the cannon at the base of the command center, the Muun stated that the cause of the destruction was down to the Republic's superior artillery. Not long after, the [[The Muunilinst 10|Muunilinst 10]] was able to infiltrate the Banking Clan's command center and forced [[San Hill/Legends|San Hill]] to surrender before they arrested the leaders.
